xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe: The aforesaid standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and on its recommendation, have been approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on November 4, 2026 in accordance with the Regulation 33 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The said results have been subjected to limited review by the statutory auditors of the Company who have issued unmodified reports thereon. The said standalone and consolidated financial results have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in the Indian Accounting Standard 34 prescribed under Section 133 of the Act and other accounting principles generally accepted in India and in compliance with Regulation 33 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The said consolidated financial results include the results of the Company along with its fourteen subsidiary companies including step-down subsidiaries, one partnership firm and one association of persons. JM Financial Middle East Limited has been incorporated on October 12, 2026, in Abu Dhabi Global Market, as a wholly owned subsidiary of JM Financial Overseas Holdings Private Limited and thereby as a step-down subsidiary of the Company. Further, JM Financial Private Wealth, Inc which was incorporated in the United States of America on November 10, 2025 has been dissolved during the quarter ended September 30, 2026 upon completion of the necessary regulatory formalities. The Board of Directors has declared an interim dividend of Rs. 1.65 per share of the face value of Re. 1 each on November 4, 2026. This will result in cash outflow of Rs. 157.91 crore in the next quarter, quarter ending December 31, 2026. During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Allotment Committee of the Board has allotted an aggregate of 45,000 equity shares of the face value of Re 1 each to the eligible employees upon exercise of their stock options. As a result the total paid up equity share capital of the Company has increased to Rs. 95,70,04,936 representing 95,70,04,936 equity shares of the face value of Re 1 each. During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, JM Financial Credit Solutions Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company has subscribed to the rights issue of JM Financial Asset Reconstruction Company Limited, a subsidiary of JMFCSL and a step-down subsidiary of the Company, and has been allotted 16,25,85,928 equity shares of the face value of Rs. 10 each for an amount aggregating to Rs. 162.59 crore. Post the investment in the aforesaid rights issue, the shareholding of JMFCSL and consequently, the indirect shareholding of the Company in JMFARC has increased from 81.77% to 84.87%. The standalone and consolidated financial results are being uploaded on the Company's website www.jmfl.com and the websites of BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited www.bseindia.com and www.nseindia.com, respectively.
